schema.unknown-keyword: `{Written}` starts a line and is not a declaration. A line begins with `struct`, `field`, `enum` or `value`, or it is a comment or blank.
schema.polymorphism-reserved: `{Word}` is reserved and does not mean anything yet. Inheritance is held back until the wire design for it is known to work, so that a notation nobody can remove is not left behind. A column that may hold one of several shapes is written today as a reference naming each of them.
schema.field-outside-struct: `field` with no `struct` above it. A member belongs to the struct declared before it, and there is none in this file yet.
schema.field-in-enum: `field` where the declaration above it is `enum {Enum}`. An enum holds `value` entries; a `field` belongs to a struct.
schema.value-outside-enum: `value` with no `enum` above it. An entry belongs to the enum declared before it, and there is none in this file yet.
schema.value-in-struct: `value` where the declaration above it is `struct {Struct}`. A struct holds `field` members; a `value` belongs to an enum.
schema.name-expected: A declaration needs a name after its keyword, and `{Written}` is where one should be.
schema.name-not-identifier: `{Written}` cannot be a name here. A name starts with a letter or an underscore and carries only letters, digits and underscores, because it becomes a type or a member in every language this tool generates.
schema.type-expected: A member needs a type, and `{Written}` is where one should be. Write a built-in type, a struct or enum declared in these files, or `foreign` and the table a value points at.
schema.foreign-target-expected: `foreign` with no table named after it. Write the table a value is a row of - `foreign Item` - or several separated by `|`.
schema.type-nested-array: An array of arrays. A type carries at most one `[]`: a cell holds a list of values, and a list of lists has no notation in a sheet.
schema.container-arity: `{Type}` takes {Wanted} type argument(s) and was given {Given}.
schema.meta-unclosed: Metadata brackets that are never closed. Write `)` at the end of the entries, and quote any value holding a comma.
schema.meta-key-expected: `{Written}` is where a metadata key should be. An entry is a key on its own or `key=value`, and entries are separated by commas.
schema.meta-value-expected: `{Key}=` with nothing after it. Write the value, or drop the `=` to leave the key as a flag.
schema.meta-duplicate-key: `{Key}` is written twice in one set of brackets. Write it once: which of the two applies is not something this can decide.
schema.meta-comment-key: `comment=` is not read here. A description is written as `///` lines above the declaration, which is what lets it run to more than one line and more than one bracket's worth of text.
schema.string-unterminated: A quoted value with no closing quote before the end of the line. A string does not run across lines here; write `\"` for a quote inside one.
schema.block-comment-unterminated: A `/*` with no `*/` after it, so the rest of the file is inside a comment.
schema.wire-tag-not-a-number: `@` needs a whole number after it, and `{Written}` is what is there. A wire tag is what a member's values travel under - `field count@2 int`.
schema.wire-tag-not-positive: A wire tag of {Tag}. Tags count from one.
schema.wire-tag-duplicate: `{Struct}.{Member}` is given tag {Tag}, which `{First}` already carries. Two members under one tag is one member as far as a reader is concerned.
schema.wire-tag-partial: `{Struct}.{Member}` carries no wire tag and other members of the same struct do. Tag all of them or none: with some tagged, what number an untagged member has depends on how many members before it happened to be tagged.
schema.enum-number-duplicate: `{Enum}.{Entry}` is given {Number}, which `{First}` already carries. Two names for one number cannot be told apart in the data.
schema.enum-value-not-a-number: `{Entry}` is given `{Written}`, and an enum entry carries a whole number.
schema.doc-comment-attached-to-nothing: A `///` description with no declaration after it. A description belongs to what it introduces; write the declaration, or make these lines `//` notes.
schema.default-value-expected: `{Member} =` with nothing after it. Write the default value, or drop the `=`.
